target_customer: Insulation, HVAC and other specialty subcontractors and general contractors that price jobs from construction drawings
problem: Estimators spend hours counting pipes, ducts and surfaces by hand from PDF plans before they can bid. Constor extracts quantities from drawings for review.
business_model: B2B SaaS for estimators; pricing not published, demo led sales
product_category: AI quantity takeoff and estimating for construction

founders.name: Louis Pires
founders.background_notes: Grew up helping his father's HVAC insulation business with takeoffs, per the YC page and launch post.

founders.name: Elio Delacour
education: PhD studies in computer science at ETH Zurich
previous_startups: Katia, a voice AI agent for medical offices (outcome not found)

founders.name: Dany Delacour
founders.background_notes: Name as shown on the YC page; a third party directory lists a different second founder name, see notes.

competitors.traction_then: 4.9 of 5 from 39 reviews on GetApp UK (vendor listing)

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading construction drawings and counting HVAC and insulation elements with computer vision is standard applied AI with hard edge cases such as scale, symbols and 3D review, but vision foundation models were available.

defensibility.rationale: Several takeoff vendors already existed and the product is a wedge for later bidding and ordering tools. Domain depth in HVAC insulation is the only visible edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established takeoff vendors were shipping AI features in 2026 (ConstructConnect announced Takeoff Boost on Google Cloud). No acquisition of Constor found.

market_need_then: Takeoff is a manual, time consuming step before every bid. Constor's website carries testimonials from French insulation company owners about saved time, which is self reported.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident and practical per the site, for example your quantity takeoffs in minutes.

brand_strength.rationale: Brand is new, no press about the brand and no community found. A similarly named ConstructAI exists in the same space.

outcome_analysis: Constor joined YC in Fall 2026 as an active three person team. One founder grew up inside an HVAC insulation business, which gives real founder market fit for takeoffs. It is too early for an outcome. The open questions are whether it can beat established takeoff vendors and expand into bidding and supplier ordering.
